disclosurePolicy: Canonical public and local physical facts, plus physically observable activity envelopes. Private and participant-only contents are withheld.

disclosure.envelope: Activity envelopes — participants, location, primitive activity, start and end time — are disclosed for every canonical activity, because an inhabitant occupying a tile for a measurable period is directly observable (claude.md §11E).
disclosure.contents: Activity contents — speech, reasoning, quantities, resolution detail — are disclosed only when the originating canonical event was public or local. `contentsDisclosed` marks each record. Withheld contents are never reconstructed, summarised or inferred.
